title: YMod
description: A Create focused modpack that’s inspired by Garry's Mod
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f197f7dd29185323b36addfa417e0c4981c7ac57.png)
This modpack is made purely for fun and experimentation. It’s mainly intended for creative mode, but you can play it in survival if you really want to. The core idea is building actual working vehicles using Create, powered by Valkyrien Skies 2, with a handful of addons included to make vehicle building smoother, less painful, and more flexible.

The focus is not progression, balance, or realism. The focus is messing around. You are expected to experiment, break things, rebuild them, and slowly turn bad ideas into something that almost works. Cars, boats, planes, if it moves, you can probably strap something to it and make it worse in a fun way.

This pack is heavily inspired by Garry’s Mod, but im Yoofluu so its YMod, It’s a sandbox first and a game second. There’s no “right” way to play it.

If you like building vehicles, experimenting with physics, and turning dumb ideas into barely functional machines, this pack is probably for you.
